summary: Super Group (SGHC) Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 25, 2026, along with a proxy card. The document is a routine foreign private issuer report containing the agenda and voting instructions for the meeting, including a board recommendation to vote in favor of the proposed resolutions. No special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes are disclosed. The filing is a standard periodic report with no actionable special-situation catalyst.
